target_semantics_lesson: Forecast Tesla's quarterly year-over-year revenue growth acceleration for the fiscal quarter ending 2024-09-30, distinguishing levels from changes.
evidence_selection_lesson: Require current, cutoff-safe evidence for each checkpoint. Support every retained outgoing relationship to validate causal bridges.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Forward-looking commentary on vehicle growth and operational efficiency can drive revenue acceleration. Test competing paths and reduce confidence for weak links.
counterevidence_lesson: Explicitly check for 'Tesla [CURRENT_PERIOD_REQUIRED] Revenue Misses Estimates.' If present, compare its evidence strength against the leading path.
calibration_lesson: Assess if evidence supports magnitude and boundary crossing, not just direction. Ensure all used checkpoint transitions correspond to preserved, currently supported edges.
